name: workflow-toolkit
description: Monorepo for workit — workflow rails for agentic coding

scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings packages/workit-core/src packages/workit-opencode/src packages/workit-cli/src packages/workit-cursor/mcp/server.ts test
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix packages/workit-core/src packages/workit-opencode/src packages/workit-cli/src packages/workit-cursor/mcp/server.ts test
scripts.format: oxfmt packages/workit-core/src packages/workit-opencode/src packages/workit-cli/src packages/workit-cursor/mcp/server.ts test package.json packages/*/package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check packages/workit-core/src packages/workit-opencode/src packages/workit-cli/src packages/workit-cursor/mcp/server.ts test package.json packages/*/package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun test && tsc --noEmit
